stem_book: In the figure shown four particles are fixed at the vertices of a massless square wire frame ABCD of side a: mass m at A (bottom-left), m at B (bottom-right), 2m at C (top-right) and 2m at D (top-left). Find the M.O.I. of the system about an axis passing through A and perpendicular to the plane of paper. (a) 3ma² (b) 5ma² (c) 6ma² (d) 7ma²
reason: missing from manifest; printed key d.
work: from A: B (m) at a, D (2m) at a, C (2m) at √2a: I = ma² + 2ma² + 2m(2a²) = 7ma²
